title: Backend and IoT Developer
bio: I am a Back-End and IoT Developer with a strong foundation in Informatics Engineering. I specialize in bridging the gap between hardware and software, leveraging technologies like Laravel, React, and ESP32 to build deploy-ready platforms. From managing Dockerized homelab environments to engineering serverless backends, I am passionate about modern infrastructure, continuous deployment, and writing clean, scalable code.
aboutMe: I am an Informatics Engineering graduate dedicated to building robust Web Back-End systems and innovative IoT solutions. My engineering philosophy centers on a hands-on, builder approach, whether I am developing full-stack web applications using Laravel and React, or designing custom IoT architectures with ESP32 microcontrollers, Node-RED, and Grafana. Through internships at multinational companies, I gained valuable experience in API integration and backend server development. Beyond writing code, I actively manage a microservices homelab using Ubuntu Server and Docker to continuously refine my DevOps and infrastructure skills. I am passionate about creating seamless integrations between hardware and software, and I am always looking for opportunities to solve complex problems and grow as an engineer.
